nodes.label: Test-Runner Discovery Probe
nodes.rationale: Manifest-driven table mapping repo-root lockfiles/manifests to the project's FULL test command, with CI workflow files as the any-language fallback. None found -> a 'tests pass' claim is impossible (never guess a command); an inline execution proof may still serve the gate, claimed narrowly.

nodes.label: Caller-Count Probe
nodes.rationale: Grep the exported symbol across files, subtract the defining file; the result feeds the >5-callers re-tier trigger in core. Shell fallbacks count the defining file, so the -1 correction is mandatory.

nodes.label: Dirty-Tree Probe
nodes.rationale: git status --porcelain before any merge/discard/branch-switch; any output = dirty -> stop, commit/stash or get an explicit user decision. Never discard silently.

nodes.label: Hidden-Coupling Probe
nodes.rationale: Mechanical detectors for connections no import reveals: co-change git archaeology (>=3 shared commits = coupled), shared DB writes, event names, shared env/config keys, duplicated magic strings. Findings feed the investigation enumeration list and the re-tier decision.
